Indore Metro Begins Underground Tunneling Work

The Indore Metro has commenced underground tunneling work, with the first tunnel boring machine (TBM) named 'Narmada' starting operations. The TBM will excavate up to a depth of 20 meters, with soil being removed via trolleys. A machine imported from abroad has been brought in for the excavation and tunneling process.
